mapper.select: SELECT reservation_id , fair_id , user_id , visit_date , reservation_type , status FROM reservations WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT fair_date_id , operation_date , capacity , entry_start_time , entry_end_time
